corpus_crossquery.query: Does the hedge erosion recorded in DL-METH-091 hold when the same authors restate the same work in a different venue?
corpus_crossquery.finding: 🔴 NO — AND THE FALSIFICATION IS SHARPER THAN THE ORIGINAL CLAIM. DL-METH-091 said a commentary by authors on their own paper is not a summary, because modality degrades. This is a review by the same laboratory on its own primary study, and the running text hedges PROPERLY throughout: 'Our recent study SUGGESTS new mechanisms', 'The first mechanism WE PROPOSE', 'it is POSSIBLE TO SPECULATE', 'is STILL TO BE INVESTIGATED', 'this is YET TO BE SHOWN'. Authorship therefore does not predict erosion. WHAT DOES, on the evidence of both papers, is the MODEL FIGURE. Here the running text that introduces Figure 1 hedges three times in two sentences, and the figure caption directly below states the same three mechanisms flatly — 'WWOX modulates ER expression and function, which in turn positively or negatively affects p53' — with no modal at all, and the drawing carries no dashed line, no question mark and no 'proposed' anywhere. The comparison is INTERNAL: same authors, same year, same venue, same paragraph. That controls for everything the venue-based explanation would need. 🔴 AND THE SECOND HALF REPLICATES PMID 27308504 EXACTLY: the one place this figure DOES hedge is ER→p53, drawn as two opposing arrows simultaneously because the authors have no directional claim there — precisely as 27308504's only hedge was a '?' on the MRN complex, the one element that was not its authors' claim. Two independent papers, same laboratory, same asymmetry: the figure marks uncertainty where the authors have no stake and states flatly where they do.

figure_coverage.budget_declared_before_reading: 🔴 FALSE AS ORIGINALLY WRITTEN, CORRECTED 2026-08-11. This field claimed the denominator was established BEFORE the body was read. The session record does not support it: the figure count and the image download both occur AFTER the body had been read in three passes. What is true is that a rough structural probe — counting 'Figure N' mentions, tables and supplementary markers — ran before the body, and the FIGURE ITSELF was located, downloaded and inspected afterwards. The claim is downgraded to what happened, because a budget's whole value is that it was fixed before the work, and a budget reported as prior when it was not is worse than none. WHAT IS UNCHANGED IS THE SUBSTANCE: the denominator contradicted the assigned perimeter. The task was framed as a whole reading with a measured panel budget, and the advice was to call supplementaryFiles first — which on another paper had returned eleven figures in one call. Measured here instead: ONE figure referenced twice in the running text, one 'Open in a new tab', ZERO tables, ZERO supplementary, and no Methods, Results or Discussion sections. The paper is a REVIEW with a single schematic. There was no supplementary to call and no panel budget to spend. Recorded because the correct denominator is what makes a coverage number mean anything, and here it turned a large-sounding task into a small one.

entries.proposition: 🔴 PANEL SIDE, QUALIFYING: THE MODALS PRESENT IN THE RUNNING TEXT ARE COMPRESSED IN THE CAPTION AND THE DRAWING. The paragraph above hedges three times in two sentences — 'suggests', 'we propose', 'possible to speculate'. The caption states the same three mechanisms without a modal, and the drawing carries no dashed stroke and no question mark. 🔴 CORRECTED 2026-08-11, AND THE CORRECTION MATTERS: the first version of this locator said the figure carries no qualification at all. THAT IS FALSE — the caption OPENS with 'WWOX regulates p53 function, model of action and scenarios', so the word MODEL is printed. What is true is narrower and still worth recording: the caption labels the whole as a model while stating each individual mechanism in the indicative, and the three specific hedges of the adjacent text do not survive into it. The comparison is INTERNAL — same authors, same year, same venue, same paragraph — which controls for what an explanation based on venue or authorship would need, and that is what makes it worth a locator. What the figure does mark is ER→p53, drawn as TWO OPPOSING LINES SIMULTANEOUSLY, matching the caption's 'positively or negatively': it is marked in the one place THE TEXT ITSELF EXPLICITLY PRESERVES DIRECTIONAL UNCERTAINTY. The earlier wording said 'where the authors have no stake', which is unmeasured psychological attribution and has been removed. PMID 27308504 shows the same shape — its only hedge a question mark on MRN, the one element its own text does not claim — so this is a hypothesis replicated twice on figures from one laboratory, not an established rule about model figures in general.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 1, native JPEG raster at 800x820. FIVE nodes: an orange-outlined 'WWOX' ellipse at the top, and four rectangles — 'Genomic instability', 'ER pathway', 'EMT' and a blue-outlined 'p53'. From WWOX: a blunt-ended line to 'Genomic instability', an arrowheaded line to 'ER pathway', a blunt-ended line to 'EMT'. From 'ER pathway' to 'p53': TWO parallel lines, the left blunt-ended and the right arrowheaded, both terminating at p53. Between 'Genomic instability' and 'p53': TWO parallel lines, BOTH blunt-ended, terminating at opposite ends — reciprocal inhibition. Between 'p53' and 'EMT': ONE line only, blunt-ended at the EMT end. Every stroke is solid; there is no dashed line and no question mark anywhere in the image, and no lettering beyond the five node labels.

entries.proposition: A HETEROZYGOUS PHENOTYPE, RECORDED AS SECONDARY EVIDENCE — WHICH IS WHAT IT IS. 🔴 CORRECTED 2026-08-11 on two counts. First: this review does not MEASURE this, it REPORTS it, citing its ref 40 = Abdeen SK, Salah Z, Maly B, et al., 'Wwox inactivation enhances mammary tumorigenesis', Oncogene 2011;30(36):3900-3906, which is not read here. The first version wrote 'named and measured', which credited a measurement to a document that contains none. Second: it also claimed this was 'the first heterozygous phenotype this corpus has anchored' — an assertion about the whole corpus made without auditing it, and withdrawn rather than defended. What survives, and is worth keeping, is the CONTRAST with PMID 27308504: there a schematic printed WWOX(+/-) while no heterozygous system existed anywhere in the primary it restated; here a heterozygous system at least EXISTS in the cited literature. And the boundary conditions weigh as much as the number — mammary tumours, in a strain chosen for mammary susceptibility, in aged animals. A cancer phenotype in a sensitised background is not a statement about carriers of a neurodevelopmental genotype and must not be transferred as one.

verbatim_locators.note: COVERAGE IS COMPLETE FOR WHAT THIS DOCUMENT CONTAINS. Abstract, Introduction, all four thematic sections, the conclusions section, the figure caption and the 120-item reference list read in sequence from the PMC HTML; the single figure inspected at its deposited resolution. There are no Methods, Results or Discussion sections — checked, not assumed: the strings do not occur as headings. No tables and no supplementary material — likewise checked. 🔴 WHAT THIS READING IS NOT: this is a REVIEW and it contains no primary data. Its value here is not evidential but comparative — it is the control that falsifies the UNIVERSAL form of DL-METH-091, showing authorship is not a SUFFICIENT condition for modality erosion. It does not show authorship has no predictive value, and it does not establish the model figure as the cause: two figures from one laboratory make that a hypothesis replicated twice. 🔴 CORRECTED 2026-08-11: this note previously ended 'the primary study it reviews is NOT read, and until it is, nothing here may be promoted'. Both halves were wrong. The primary is PMID 30082886, and it was read completely in this corpus the day before — FTR-20260810-30082886-01. The blocker on promotion is therefore not a missing reading but an unperformed COMPARISON between this review and that persisted reading, which is the task now written into FT-062.
